title: Outpatient visit
_note: Sample 3-step hospital visit. Scene and hotspot ids are Simba Saloon photos standing in for a hospital (entrance, reception, pharmacy); the narration is what a hospital would say.

sentences.text: Welcome to Riverside Hospital. This is the main entrance, open day and night.
Drop-off is right here by the doors. Visitor parking is on your left, and it's free for the first two hours.
Walk straight down this corridor to reception.
Please have your ID and insurance card ready. If this is your first visit, we'll register you here; it takes about five minutes.
Then take a seat, and a nurse will call your name for triage.
After you've seen the doctor, come here to collect your medicine.
The pharmacy window is just ahead. Hand in your prescription, and you'll pay at the same counter.
That's the end of your visit. The exit is back the way you came. We wish you a quick recovery.
